style: Original art-directed sports poster, not a photograph of the real event. One or two figures only, the rest of the frame is design: a single dominant colour, hard graphic light, vast negative space, the figure rendered as a monumental silhouette or rim-lit form. The one gesture that defines the moment, larger than life. The whole frame is picture: no text anywhere, no title, no caption, no credits, no watermark, no logos, no jersey lettering or numbers. Figures are flat silhouettes or rim-lit shapes with no visible faces, no real people, and every figure is whole, never a collage of cut-out parts.

moments.title: The Last Shot
moments.prompt: A lone shooter frozen in a perfect follow-through, wrist bent, fingers pointing at the rim, seen from behind and below against a wall of blinding white light. The whole arena is reduced to one giant glowing scoreboard reading 5.2 in the dark above him. Red figure, black void, white light.

moments.title: The Block
moments.prompt: Shot from directly behind the backboard: a hand and forearm slamming a basketball flat against the glass, the shooter's hand still underneath it, both arms stretched to their limit. Wine-red and gold light, the glass cracking into a star pattern around the ball, nothing else in frame.

moments.title: The Flu Game
moments.prompt: A single black silhouette of a basketball player on his knees at centre court, seen from behind, head bowed, one hand flat on the floor, the centre circle glowing beneath him like a halo. Everything else black. One beam of sickly grey-green light from above and a red wash across his back. No other figure in the frame, no equipment of any kind.

moments.title: From the Line
moments.prompt: A human basketball player in full flight, body stretched perfectly horizontal, legs split, one arm holding the ball high, drawn as a flat red-and-gold silhouette of an athlete in strict side profile. Below him the free-throw line glows as the only mark on a black floor and a dotted arc traces his flight from the line to a rim at the right edge. A human body with arms and legs, not an object.

moments.title: The Skyhook
moments.prompt: One very tall, thin basketball player drawn as a flat black silhouette, seen from far below so he towers out of the frame, his shooting arm straight up releasing a one-handed hook shot, the ball just leaving his fingertips at the very top of the picture, the shot arc a thin golden line curving away toward a rim beyond the edge. Flat purple field, gold light, no other figures, no buildings, no monument.

moments.title: The Junior Skyhook
moments.prompt: A point guard mid-stride across the lane, lofting a running one-handed hook, the ball leaving his fingertips in a shaft of gold light, two defenders behind him dissolved into green smoke. Gold figure, green haze, a clock reading :02 burned faintly into the dark.

moments.title: The Shrug
moments.prompt: A player seen from the front, shoulders raised, palms turned up, head tilted, the universal shrug, lit from below like a statue. Six basketballs hang in a perfect row in the air above him like a halo. Red figure on a deep black field.

moments.title: The Dream Shake
moments.prompt: A centre on the low block drawn as a multiple exposure: four ghost silhouettes of the same figure pivoting one way, then the other, then rising for the shot, the last one solid. Flat scarlet shapes on black with a glowing gold motion trail. One defender a dim silhouette leaning the wrong way. Blank featureless figures, blank uniforms.

moments.title: The Stepover
moments.prompt: Shot from floor level: a guard's huge foot and leg stepping over a fallen opponent, the standing guard a solid white silhouette towering out of the top of the frame, the fallen player a flat purple-and-gold shape sprawled across a glowing white floor. One hard spotlight, long hard shadows. Two complete solid silhouettes with blank uniforms.

moments.title: The Lob
moments.prompt: A basketball hanging at the apex of its arc at the very top of the frame, and far below two giant hands rising to meet it, the rest of the player's body falling into darkness. Gold light, the ball's arc drawn as a thin bright line from the bottom corner. Nothing else.

moments.title: From the Logo
moments.prompt: A slight guard releasing a jumper from a distance so absurd the rim is a tiny bright circle at the far top of the frame, the ball a glowing dot halfway there, the court stretched to a vanishing point between them. Blue and gold on a black floor, the half-court circle glowing under his feet. The picture fills the whole frame edge to edge with no border, no title band and no caption area.

moments.title: The Dagger
moments.prompt: A shooter at the top of a step-back, the defender's outstretched hand a half-second late, the ball leaving his hand with a long bright trail that turns into the shape of a dagger blade. Wine-red and gold, 53 seconds glowing faintly in the black.

moments.title: Eighty-One
moments.prompt: A guard in purple walking alone off a court, back to camera, the hardwood behind him covered in eighty-one glowing shot marks, each a small burst of light, forming a constellation over the floor. Black arena, purple figure, gold sparks.

moments.title: The First Team
moments.prompt: Exactly five colossal silhouettes, five separate figures standing shoulder to shoulder in one line across the horizon of an empty glowing court the size of a city, seen from far away and below like a mountain range, sunset light pouring between them. Each of the five a different colour: black, green, red, purple, gold. The final boss of a climb through basketball history.
